subject: Quick note: Recap from our discovery + one quick question on fit
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@brightlane.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:20:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: Discovery call — Redwood + Brightlane (15 Nov)

Hi Elena — thanks again for taking the time last week. Quick recap and two small asks so we can shape a pilot if this is a fit:

Key points from our call:
- Primary goal: improve triage throughput for intake pipeline by 30% while keeping model hallucination rate under 2%.
- Expected traffic: ~25k inference calls/day, peak 40k/day (weekday spikes).
- Data constraints: PHI redaction required; Brightlane will keep PII on-prem and send de-identified payloads.
- Success metrics: latency p90 < 400ms, cost per 1k tokens < $0.60 (target), and QA pass rate > 98% on sampled outputs.

What I attached: discovery summary + a short pricing snapshot tied to the throughput you described (see attachments).

Two quick asks: 
1) Can you confirm whether the procurement timeline still targets a December pilot kickoff?
2) Is there anyone on your security/compliance team I should loop in now so we can expedite the SOC2 / KMS checklist?

If it helps, I can share a 15‑minute checklist readout for your security team and a proposed 6-week pilot plan we’d run under a short MSA.

Thanks — if this looks on track, what’s the best time next week for a 15‑minute follow-up?

Warmly,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0118 | hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-discovery-summary.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); pricing-snapshot.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@brightlane.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Quick bump: Recap + procurement timing?

Hi Elena —

Just bumping this in case it got buried — totally understand how busy things are this time of year. Two quick options if helpful:
- 15 minutes this week to confirm procurement timing and next steps, or
- If you’re not owning procurement, could you point me to the right person on your side?

If priorities shifted and Brightlane is not looking to move in the next 60 days, that’s totally fine — a quick reply with timing helps us avoid unnecessary follow-ups.

Thanks,
Hannah

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick bump: Recap + procurement timing?

Hannah / Monica —

FYI: Elena hasn’t replied. My suggestion: try one more brief, zero-friction touch offering a short artifact they can forward to procurement — e.g., a 1‑page security summary and a pilot SOW with dates. If still no response, mark as nurture and set reminder for Jan.

If you want, I can draft the one‑pager security note (SOC2, data flow, KMS options) and the SOW template. Happy to jump on a quick call to align.

— Diego
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@brightlane.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final quick ask — feedback on fit?

Hi Elena —

Hope you’re well. I don’t want to flood you; this will be my last note for a bit unless you want to pick this back up. Two very quick asks that take less than a minute: 

1) Is this something Brightlane would consider running a short pilot for (yes / maybe / no)?
2) If maybe or no, any quick feedback on why (timing, budget, security, other)?

If you want the materials Diego mentioned, I can send a 1‑page security summary and a proposed 6‑week SOW that procurement can review — happy to customize. If now isn’t the right time, please tell me a month that works better and I’ll check back then.

Appreciate any guidance — even a single word helps.

Thanks again,
Hannah
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0118 | hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

--
Hannah Schmitt
Redwood Inference
